notes.title: Patch Note Ver1.1.2
notes.content:
To Our English-Speaking Users,

We apologize for the poor localization that has been in place for a long time. We have released a patch version that fixes the English localization. In addition to correcting awkward sentences, we have revised Mahjong terms such as "Reach" to "Riichi".

notes.title: Beta branch for v1.1.0 is now live
notes.content:
Sure, here is the English translation of your update announcement:

[h1]v1.1.0[/h1]

We are releasing the beta version of v1.1.0. After adjustments, it will be merged into the default branch.

Note: Depending on the adjustments, the rankings during the v1.1.0 beta period may be reset.

[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added Drop Mode, allowing players to create a pair at any time.
[*] Added new Yaku: Peace, Double Riichi, Tenhou, Kokushi Musou, and Suu Ankou.
[*] Added the Kanchan Taatsu (closed wait) tile combination.
[*] Modified Kanchan Taatsu and Toitsu (pair) to transform into Ryanmen Taatsu (open wait) combinations.
[/list]

[h2]Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed tile removal between rounds to a choice of action that consumes score points.
[*] Changed higher-tier Yakuman such as Suu Ankou Tanki to single Yakuman from double Yakuman.
[*] Changed the game over conditions and made them visible.
[*] Removed the tutorial and replaced it with Tips.
[*] Overhauled the UI.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the Ippatsu (one-shot) bonus was removed when declaring Ron.
[*] Fixed a bug where Mentsu overflow (too many sets) occurred.
[*] Corrected errors in some score calculations.
[*] Fixed an issue where the screen size reverted when transitioning to the title screen in windowed mode.
[/list]

[*] Added new Yaku: Peace, Double Riichi, Tenhou, Kokushi Musou, and Suu Ankou.
[*] Added the Kanchan Taatsu (closed wait) tile combination.
[*] Modified Kanchan Taatsu and Toitsu (pair) to transform into Ryanmen Taatsu (open wait) combinations.

[*] Changed higher-tier Yakuman such as Suu Ankou Tanki to single Yakuman from double Yakuman.
[*] Changed the game over conditions and made them visible.

[*] Fixed an issue where the screen size reverted when transitioning to the title screen in windowed mode.
